native_menu_app_about: App menu item that opens the About panel (macOS menu bar).
native_menu_app_hide: App menu item that hides the Atlas app (macOS).
native_menu_app_hide_others: App menu item that hides every other app (macOS).
native_menu_app_quit: App menu item that quits Atlas (macOS menu bar). The tray's quit item follows each OS's own word.
native_menu_app_services: App menu item that opens the macOS Services submenu.
native_menu_app_settings: App menu item that opens Atlas Settings. Each OS names it its own way: Settings (macOS 13+, Windows), Preferences (Linux desktops). pt-BR on macOS is Ajustes, as in the system's own menus. i18n-allow glossary:settings
native_menu_capture_all_in_one: Capture menu item: the overlay that takes a region, window, screen, text or recording from one place.
native_menu_capture_fullscreen: Capture menu item: screenshot of a whole display.
native_menu_capture_gif: Capture menu item: screen recording saved as a GIF.
native_menu_capture_ocr: Capture menu item: read the text of a region you drag.
native_menu_capture_previous: Capture menu item: screenshot of the region captured last time.
native_menu_capture_region: Capture menu item: screenshot of a region you drag.
native_menu_capture_window: Capture menu item: screenshot of a window you pick.
native_menu_edit_cut: Edit menu item that cuts the selection to the clipboard.
native_menu_edit_paste: Edit menu item that pastes the clipboard.
native_menu_edit_redo: Edit menu item that redoes the last undone change.
native_menu_edit_select_all: Edit menu item that selects the whole content of the focused field, editor or terminal.
native_menu_file_close_all_tabs: File menu item that closes every tab of the pane.
native_menu_file_close_other_tabs: File menu item that closes every tab of the pane but the active one.
native_menu_file_close_tab: File menu item that closes the active tab.
native_menu_file_new_agent_session: File menu item that starts a coding agent in a new tab.
native_menu_file_new_browser_tab: File menu item that opens a tab with the embedded browser.
native_menu_file_new_terminal: File menu item that opens a terminal tab.
native_menu_file_new_worktree: File menu item that opens the new worktree dialog.
native_menu_file_reopen_tab: File menu item that brings back the tab closed last.
native_menu_file_save_all: File menu item that saves every modified file.
native_menu_go_changes: Go menu item that opens the git changes of the worktree.
native_menu_go_config: Go menu item that opens the project's atlas.yaml viewer.
native_menu_go_file: Go menu item that opens the file finder.
native_menu_go_jump: Go menu item that opens the jump list of worktrees and terminals.
native_menu_go_logs: Go menu item that opens the logs of the project's services.
native_menu_go_next_tab: Go menu item that activates the next tab.
native_menu_go_palette: Go menu item that opens the command palette.
native_menu_go_previous_tab: Go menu item that activates the previous tab.
native_menu_go_restart_service: Go menu item that restarts the service whose log or terminal has the focus.
native_menu_go_search: Go menu item that opens the search across the project's files.
native_menu_go_switch_branch: Go menu item that opens the branch switcher.
native_menu_help_shortcuts: Help menu item that opens the list of keyboard shortcuts.
native_menu_title_capture: Title of the Capture menu in the menu bar and of the Capture submenu of the tray menu: screenshots and recordings.
native_menu_title_file: Title of the File menu in the menu bar.
native_menu_title_go: Title of the Go menu (jump to a worktree, file, tab or screen) in the menu bar.
native_menu_title_help: Title of the Help menu in the menu bar.
native_menu_title_view: Title of the View menu in the menu bar.
native_menu_title_window: Title of the Window menu in the menu bar.
native_menu_view_actual_size: View menu item that resets the interface zoom.
native_menu_view_enter_full_screen: View menu item that makes the window full screen (macOS).
native_menu_view_split_down: View menu item that splits the active pane, the new one below.
native_menu_view_split_right: View menu item that splits the active pane, the new one on the right.
native_menu_view_toggle_bottom_dock: View menu item that shows or hides the bottom dock of the workbench.
native_menu_view_toggle_left_dock: View menu item that shows or hides the left dock of the workbench.
native_menu_view_toggle_right_dock: View menu item that shows or hides the right sidebar of the workbench.
native_menu_view_toggle_sidebar: View menu item that shows or hides the project sidebar.
native_menu_view_zoom_in: View menu item that enlarges the interface.
native_menu_view_zoom_out: View menu item that shrinks the interface.
native_menu_view_zoom_pane: View menu item that enlarges the active pane to the whole workbench (and back).
native_menu_window_minimize: Window menu item that minimizes the window to the Dock.
native_menu_window_zoom: Window menu item that toggles the window between its size and the largest one (macOS Zoom, not the interface zoom).
